title: Issue tracker: filters, multi-key sort and keyset cursor pagination through handler/service/storage for two backends

hidden_checks.spec: Rule 11: without limit/cursor the response is exactly {"items": [...]} (no next_cursor), all matching items; rule 9 default order id; rule 18.
Rule 18: creation/validation, GET /issues/<id>, 404s unchanged.
Rule 4: status values OR; all = no filter; all with another value, empty or unknown values -> invalid_filter/status.
Rule 5: an issue must carry every given label; empty label -> invalid_filter/label.
Rule 6: none = unassigned; otherwise exact case-sensitive match; empty -> invalid_filter/assignee.
Rule 7: q.casefold() substring of title.casefold() (straße finds STRASSE, ÉMILE finds Émile); empty q applies no filter.
Rules 4-7: all given filters must pass.
Rule 8: priority ascending puts 1 first; id ascending appended as final key.
Rule 8: '-' prefix descending per key, created/updated map to created_at/updated_at, explicit id (any direction) suppresses the implicit one.
Rule 8: title compares title.casefold() by code point; rule 17: SQLite NOCASE does not implement this.
Rule 8: unknown key, empty entry or the same key twice -> invalid_sort/sort.
Rule 10: decimal digits only and 1..100, else invalid_limit/limit.
Rules 12/13: paged mode returns items + next_cursor; next_cursor non-null iff more matching items exist after the last returned one.
Rules 12-14: following next_cursor reproduces the full order for every sort without gaps, duplicates or empty trailing pages.
Rules 4-8 and 14: pagination over filtered, multi-key sorted results.
Rule 12: page size is 25 when only cursor is given.
Rule 15: limit may differ between pages; rule 14 keyset continuation.
Rule 15: different sort/status set/labels -> cursor_mismatch; status order/repetition and all vs no status do not matter; sort compared after rule 8.
Rule 15: a value the server did not produce (garbage, empty) -> invalid_cursor/cursor.
Rule 14: a new issue that sorts before the captured position is not returned and causes no duplicates (keyset, not offset).
Rule 14: issues created after the first page appear if they sort after the captured position.
Rule 14: the cursor captures the sort-key values; updating the item that produced it does not move the position; issues placed by current values.
Rules 1-3: unknown_param first (alphabetically first name), then duplicate_param in the order assignee, q, sort, limit, cursor, then validation order status, label, assignee, q, sort, limit, cursor.
Rule 9: export default order created then id; rule 16 filters apply.
Rules 1, 16: export applies filters/sort (casefold q), keeps the CSV format, rejects limit/cursor as unknown_param and validates sort/status.
